notes.depth: Evidence depth is dataset dependency. These edges do not carry row-level proof, and lineage navigation does not certify any value.
notes.bronze: Declared A24 bronze sources are listed per dataset and are deliberately not drawn as edges: the file does not state which bronze source feeds which dependency.
notes.symbolic: A symbolic collection such as C1_MARTS stands for a set of upstream datasets. It is shown as a collection, never resolved into physical tables.
notes.boundary: An upstream node with no dataset row of its own is a boundary node. Its own lineage is outside this metadata.
notes.scope: This is dataset lineage only. No transaction, journal or finding chain is drawn, because this metadata does not contain one.
